sections.h2: Lysine's import value fell 21.7%, driven mainly by a fall in unit price

chart.title: Price did most of the work: unit price fell 18.7% against 4% lower volume
chart.source: DGCI&S data, via this blog's registry.

sections.means: The fall in lysine's import value came mostly from lower prices, not from buying much less.

sections.h2: China supplies most of the world's lysine, by two industry estimates
